title: Forgotten Realms Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose armies fight alongside angels and which is threatened by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Rimewind
entities.description: Aberrant magic that drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A power that, it is suggested, may be surpassed by even greater powers.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of choices altering the path of fate.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that threaten Zendikar's future.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who prophesies a vast shout followed by a vaster silence.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: A being so great that only one vault, the moon, could hold her.

entities.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
entities.description: A figure who threatens to extract the cost of opposition from foes' wits.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane once home to blinkmoths, whose creator still lives and shapes metal.

entities.name: Branko One-Ear
entities.description: A speaker who mocks a slumlord's vile tenement.

entities.name: Zul Ashur
entities.description: A lich lord who raises skeletons and takes bounty from his victims' deaths.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: A final rest that all crave but few receive.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker who shapes molten earth by infusing it with rage.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker who declares that what he desires shall be.

entities.name: Nundari
entities.description: A Sea Gate militia captain who trains for the improbable.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A place with a militia led in part by Nundari.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A ravenous dragonlord who conquered Qadat and whose hunger threatens all of Tarkir.

entities.name: Qadat
entities.description: A fiery realm inhabited by efreet, conquered by Atarka long ago.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: A performer who calls everyone to their places.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god whose forge burns in the heart of Mount Velus.

entities.name: Mount Velus
entities.description: A mountain housing Purphoros's forge, which attracts dragons.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A stormy realm that shouts its approval with lightning.

entities.name: Euphemia
entities.description: A Nexus watcher who says monsters dwell in every heart.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: A Sun Empire knight who speaks of might protecting empires.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: An empire whose knights include Inti.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: The Golgari Lich-Lord, who finds wisdom in death.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A faction led by the lich-lord Jarad.

entities.name: Galea
entities.description: A protector who shields allies from wrathful flames.

entities.name: Emmara
entities.description: A speaker who asserts that nature is stronger than civilization.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: A force likened to a river that cannot be controlled.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: A speaker who warns that Atarka would feast on all of Tarkir if unchecked.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane threatened by Atarka's hunger.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A world where death and chaos hold no sway, with pure hearts and bright skies.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: A speaker who warns that the Cult of Rakdos is a danger.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A dangerous cult of spectacle whose signets are made of bone and used as murder weapons.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who whispers to the remaining consciousness of the gods Oketra and Bontu.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god with some consciousness left, whom Liliana urges against the usurper.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god with some consciousness left, whom Liliana urges against the usurper.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A long-dead figure who wanted slivers to be mindless instruments of destruction.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures that have become mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The khan of the Mardu, who came seeking a challenge.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A clan led by Zurgo as khan.

entities.name: Magic Mirror
entities.description: A mirror that crystallized a drop of water into something much more.

entities.name: Goma Fada caravan
entities.description: An endlessly traveling caravan whose mages harness life and death.

entities.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
entities.description: A figure who believes he can obtain anything.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A faction whose territorial markings are smeared in blood, snot, and muck.

entities.name: Wahara
entities.description: The Keeper of the Crucible, which yields what one has forged in the mind.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who describes mana as possibility.

entities.name: Tullus of Palandius
entities.description: A speaker who urges reliance on one's own knowledge rather than seekers or sphinxes.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent beneath a blanket of dense vegetation.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A volcanic continent with gas vents and jagged peaks.

entities.name: Gadwick, the Wizened
entities.description: A wizard who demands visitors approach his tower on bended knee.

entities.name: Underdark
entities.description: A subterranean realm whose flooding has swallowed ancient drow burial chambers.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: An expansive canvas painted by precise, controlling hands.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist whose trees were transformed one morning.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A continent that is a vast plateau of trenches and rivers.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A geothermal swampland continent reeking of heat and decay.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A continent of rushing waters, narrow canyons, and mist-cloaked lakes.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A faction served by the children of the city-tree.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who hears the wind whisper 'come home' but cannot return.

events.summary: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind draws the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle again.
events.quote: The aberrant magic of the Rimewind drew the unicorns back from the northern wastes to do battle once again.

events.summary: Emrakul is imprisoned in the moon, the only vault great enough to hold her.
events.quote: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

events.summary: Long ago, Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, winning over its efreet (recounted in the past).
events.quote: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

events.summary: Liliana whispers to the remaining consciousness of Oketra and Bontu, urging them to act against the usurper.
events.quote: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left.

events.summary: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become the mindless instruments of destruction he wanted.
events.quote: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.
